Conversely, Mars (lord of H2/H9) is in an "over-ripe" state (0.35 eff), indicating a mature and steady drive in pursuing life goals `{planet:D1.Ju}, {planet:D1.Ma}`.

diagnosis.headline: Personal effort yields steady forward momentum despite temporary detachment pressing your creative pursuits and social alliances.
paragraphs: Your chart is governed by Pisces lagna, with its ruler Jupiter stationed in the seventh house in Virgo. Jupiter anchors your life in relational intelligence, public conduct, and structured counsel. You are currently navigating your major Kaala period of Jupiter (2023-10-23 to 2034-10-22), an expansive eleven-year phase that stabilizes your vitality, status, and collective responsibilities across the board.

Inside this larger cycle, you are operating in the sub-period of Mars (2026-05-05 to 2026-12-12). Mars rules your second house of wealth and ninth house of fortune, seated securely in its own sign of Scorpio in the ninth house. Mars sits in the third sign from Jupiter, establishing an upachaya relation of growth through persistent courage, direct initiative, and disciplined enterprise.

The sharpest friction pressing you right now is the sub-sub-period of Ketu, running from 2026-11-05 until 2026-12-12. Positioned in the eleventh house and opposing Rahu in the fifth, Ketu triggers the chart's natal Kala Sarpa axis, bringing sudden mental aloofness, creative hesitation, and emotional distance with friends or associates. This contraction is brief and clears completely at the sub-period boundary on 2026-12-12.

actions.text: Do not force social alignment or creative output while Ketu tests your focus; concentrate instead on practical financial organization.

stuck.headline: A temporary wave of mental withdrawal and social coolness demands quiet patience until mid-December.
paragraphs: The core resistance you feel today stems directly from the activation of Ketu in your eleventh house in Capricorn from 2026-11-05 to 2026-12-12. Ketu activates your natal Kala Sarpa axis across the fifth and eleventh houses, casting its gaze on Rahu in Cancer. This induces a temporary sense of creative fatigue, skepticism toward broader social networks, and emotional detachment from peers and collaborative goals.

This knot is further compounded by your natal Moon in Scorpio in the ninth house, which experiences the restrictive tenth aspect of Saturn from the seventh house. Saturn's gaze onto your mind's karaka introduces cautious second-guessing and an instinct to pull inward whenever external demands accelerate. Fortunately, this pressure carries an absolute expiration date: the Ketu sub-sub-period closes on 2026-12-12, handing momentum over to supportive alignments from 2026-12-13 onward.

actions.text: Refrain from cutting off long-term alliances or abandoning intellectual projects during this short phase of emotional disinterest.

paragraphs: Your running sub-period belongs to Mars, spanning 2026-05-05 to 2026-12-12. Seated in its own sign of Scorpio in the ninth house, Mars forms a beneficial Dhana Yoga with the debilitated Moon, which is strengthened by Neecha Bhanga cancellation. This sub-period has tasked you with building tangible security, defending personal assets, and stepping boldly into independent responsibilities.

From the vantage of main lord Jupiter in the seventh house, Mars operates in the third sign, an upachaya relationship. This classical geometry indicates that outcomes require persistent personal labor and decisive execution rather than passive good fortune. The closing stretch under Ketu pratyantardasha (2026-11-05 to 2026-12-12) asks you to tie up loose ends and clear mental clutter before the sub-period concludes on 2026-12-12.

chapters.headline: A decade of wisdom, institutional growth, and public engagement bridges your past intellectual training and future comfort.
paragraphs: Your overarching narrative is charted by three major Kaala epochs. Between 2015-01-05 and 2023-10-23, you navigated the major period of Mercury, lord of your fourth and seventh houses seated in the eighth. That chapter compelled you to resolve underlying obligations, navigate intricate contractual adjustments, and develop deep analytical discernment.

On 2023-10-23, you crossed into the eleven-year major period of lagna lord Jupiter, which commands your life until 2034-10-22. Holding lordship over both your first and tenth houses from the seventh, Jupiter brings your wisdom, executive judgment, and reputation into open public visibility. The journey through this mahadasha develops systematically through successive sub-periods, with the present Mars phase yielding to subsequent chapters leading through key boundaries on 2027-10-02, 2028-10-04, 2029-12-20, 2031-05-19, and 2032-12-28.

When this foundational Jupiter cycle draws to its close on 2034-10-22, you will enter the thirteen-year major period of Venus, running from 2034-10-22 to 2048-01-02. Venus rules your third and eighth houses and activates Viparita Raja Yoga from the sixth house, shifting your life into an era centered on strategic resource refinement and quiet mastery over long-term responsibilities.

actions.text: Anchor your primary ambitions around mentorship, advisory leadership, and legitimate public contracts under Jupiter's umbrella.

lagna.headline: You navigate life through deep philosophical contemplation while the world recognizes you for executive leadership and professional gravitas.
paragraphs: Your ascendant is Pisces, ruled by Jupiter, establishing a reflective, receptive, and ethically grounded personal core. Because Jupiter sits in the 7th house in Virgo alongside the Sun and Saturn, your vitality and identity are profoundly realized through the mirror of key partnerships and negotiated contracts. The 1st house receives aspects from the Sun, Jupiter, and Saturn, imposing a sober, disciplined maturity onto an otherwise fluid nature, requiring you to balance boundless imagination with exact, structured commitments.

A striking contrast defines your inner reality versus your outer image. Your Arudha Lagna (AL) and Sree Lagna (SL) fall in the 10th house in Sagittarius, the realm of career and public authority,. While your internal orientation remains contemplative, the world views you as an established, values-driven executive or mentor. The presence of Mandi and Gulika in the 10th house brings heavy karmic accountability to your reputation, demanding uncompromised integrity in public life,.

In the Navamsa (D9), the ascendant shifts to Leo, revealing that as life matures, your initial Piscean deference consolidates into decisive, sovereign leadership. You are learning to anchor an adaptable spirit within unshakeable personal dignity.

actions.text: Structure your professional responsibilities clearly so your public leadership persona does not encroach upon essential private contemplation.

paragraphs: Your emotional core is formed by the Moon in Scorpio in the 9th house, in Kaettai (Jyeshtha) nakshatra. While the Moon occupies its debilitation sign and carries the volatile imprint of Ganda Moola, its conjunction with its domicile lord Mars grants a potent Neecha Bhanga cancellation,. This configuration subjects you to sudden visceral moods and intense internal demands, yet it ultimately crafts remarkable emotional resilience from psychological friction.

Your mental processing is governed by Mercury in Libra in the 8th house, directing the intellect toward research, hidden mechanics, and thorough psychological audits,. With the 4th house (Gemini) boasting a high Sarvashtakavarga score of 35, your domestic sanctuary and deeper heart possess strong intrinsic resilience, despite Saturn's aspect onto both the Moon and the 4th house causing bouts of emotional reticence and solitary brooding,.

Under the running Kaala sub-sub-period of Ketu until 2026-12-12, the Rahu-Ketu axis across the 5th and 11th houses triggers feelings of speculative alienation and mental detachment,. By stepping back from intellectual fixation and grounding yourself in methodical problem-solving, mental turbulence resolves as the sub-sub-period shifts after December 12.

body.headline: Physical stamina rests on disciplined habits, though digestive rhythms and recovery require deliberate daily pacing.
paragraphs: Your physical constitution is anchored by a Pisces Ascendant with its ruling planet Jupiter placed in the seventh house in Virgo, casting its protective aspect back onto the first house. This provides a steady baseline of vitality and endurance throughout your running Jupiter main period, which safeguards your physical footing through 2034-10-22. However, because Saturn and the Sun also aspect the first house, your bodily vitality demands consistent structure, as mental stress or overwork directly reflects in physical tension and nervous depletion.

Wear and metabolic strain concentrate primarily in the digestive and recovery systems. Leo in the sixth house holds Venus, while Mercury occupies the eighth house in Libra with a low Sarvashtakavarga score of 18, pointing to delayed recuperation when overworked. Mars in Scorpio in the ninth house strengthens the muscular framework and lower body, yet Saturn's aspect onto both Mars and the Moon signals intermittent drops in emotional energy that can wear on stamina. In the D30 Trimsamsa, a Taurus Ascendant ruled by Venus in the eighth house reinforces the need to guard against systemic fatigue and irregular dietary habits.

Under the active Mars sub-period ending 2026-12-12 and the Ketu sub-sub-period running until 2026-12-12, heat and nervous exhaustion are the primary sources of friction. Transiting Saturn through your first house demands careful pacing and joint care, while the transit of Ketu and Jupiter through your sixth house emphasizes strict hygiene in work rhythms and meals to prevent inflammation and digestive strain.

paragraphs: Your chart contains powerful structural gifts anchored by strong planetary interactions. The conjunction of the second lord Mars in its own sign of Scorpio with the fifth lord Moon in the ninth house forms a potent Dhana Yoga, generating long-term resources, family support, and financial fortune through disciplined efforts. Furthermore, because the Moon is debilitated in Scorpio alongside its domicile ruler Mars, classical Neecha Bhanga Raja Yoga takes full effect, transforming early emotional vulnerability and crisis into profound resilience and intuitive insight.

In addition, the Moon in the Gandanta degree of Jyeshtha brings a Ganda Moola knot concerning faith and mentorship.
